question: For email lists with names starting with C (case insensitive) and containing faculty who teach courses in the summer in financial aid years after 2001, provide the name of the list, the number of people in the list, and the number of faculty in the list.

prediction.sql:
SELECT 
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS num_people,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) AS num_faculty
FROM MOIRA_LIST ml
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL mld ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE LOWER(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'c%'
  AND mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT ccs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
      FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs
      JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at ON ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
      WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM = 'Y'
        AND at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR > '2001'
        AND ccs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
  )
GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
ORDER BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME

SELECT l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
       COUNT(DISTINCT d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS people,
       COUNT(DISTINCT d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) AS faculty
FROM MOIRA_LIST l
JOIN MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL d ON l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME LIKE 'C%'
  AND d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
      FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so
      JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t ON so.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
      WHERE t.TERM_CODE LIKE '%SU%'
        AND t.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR > '2001'
        AND so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
  )
GROUP BY l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
ORDER BY l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
